verses.original: Καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι εἰσίν τινες ὧδε τῶν ἑστηκότων οἵτινες οὐ μὴ γεύσωνται θανάτου ἕως ἂν ἴδωσιν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐληλυθυῖαν ἐν δυνάμει
verses.transliteration: Kai elegen autois Amēn legō hymin hoti eisin tines hōde tōn hestēkotōn hoitines ou mē geusōntai thanatou heōs an idōsin tēn basileian tou Theou elēlythuian en dynamei
verses.literal: Then Jesus said to them Truly I tell you there are some standing here who will not taste death before . . . they see the kingdom of God arrive with power
verses.literalPt: DIZIA-LHES também: Em verdade vos digo que, dos que aqui estão, alguns há que não provarão a morte sem que vejam chegado o reino de Deus com poder.

verses.original: Καὶ μετὰ ἡμέρας ἓξ παραλαμβάνει ὁ Ἰησοῦς τὸν Πέτρον καὶ τὸν Ἰάκωβον καὶ τὸν Ἰωάννην καὶ ἀναφέρει αὐτοὺς εἰς ὄρος ὑψηλὸν κατ’ ἰδίαν μόνους καὶ μετεμορφώθη ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai meta hēmeras hex paralambanei ho Iēsous ton Petron kai ton Iakōbon kai ton Iōannēn kai anapherei autous eis oros hypsēlon kat’ idian monous kai metemorphōthē emprosthen autōn
verses.literal: After six days Jesus took with Him Peter - James and John and led them up . . . . . . a high mountain by themselves . . . There He was transfigured before them
verses.literalPt: E seis dias depois Jesus tomou consigo a Pedro, a Tiago, e a João, e os levou sós, em particular, a um alto monte; e transfigurou-se diante deles;

verses.original: καὶ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο στίλβοντα λευκὰ λίαν οἷα γναφεὺς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς οὐ δύναται οὕτως λευκᾶναι
verses.transliteration: kai ta himatia autou egeneto stilbonta leuka lian hoia gnapheus epi tēs gēs ou dynatai houtōs leukanai
verses.literal: His clothes became radiantly . . . white brighter than any launderer on earth could bleach them
verses.literalPt: E as suas vestes tornaram-se resplandecentes, extremamente brancas como a neve, tais como nenhum lavadeiro sobre a terra os poderia branquear.

verses.original: καὶ ὤφθη αὐτοῖς Ἠλίας σὺν Μωϋσεῖ καὶ ἦσαν συλλαλοῦντες τῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ōphthē autois Ēlias syn Mōusei kai ēsan syllalountes tō Iēsou
verses.literal: And Elijah and Moses appeared before them - talking with Jesus
verses.literalPt: E apareceu-lhes Elias, com Moisés, e falavam com Jesus.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Πέτρος λέγει τῷ Ἰησοῦ Ῥαββί καλόν ἐστιν ἡμᾶς ὧδε εἶναι καὶ ποιήσωμεν τρεῖς σκηνάς σοὶ μίαν καὶ Μωϋσεῖ μίαν καὶ Ἠλίᾳ μίαν
verses.transliteration: Kai apokritheis ho Petros legei tō Iēsou Rhabbi kalon estin hēmas hōde einai kai poiēsōmen treis skēnas soi mian kai Mōusei mian kai Ēlia mian
verses.literal: Peter said to Jesus Rabbi it is good for us to be here Let us put up three shelters one for You one for Moses and one for Elijah
verses.literalPt: E Pedro, tomando a palavra, disse a Jesus: Mestre, é bom que estejamos aqui; e façamos três cabanas, uma para ti, outra para Moisés, e outra para Elias.

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ ᾔδει τί ἀποκριθῇ ἔκφοβοι γὰρ ἐγένοντο
verses.transliteration: ou gar ēdei ti apokrithē ekphoboi gar egenonto
verses.literal: For they were all so terrified that Peter did not know what else to say
verses.literalPt: Pois não sabia o que dizia, porque estavam assombrados.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο νεφέλη ἐπισκιάζουσα αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐγένετο φωνὴ ἐκ τῆς νεφέλης Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός ἀκούετε αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto nephelē episkiazousa autois kai egeneto phōnē ek tēs nephelēs Houtos estin ho Huios mou ho agapētos akouete autou
verses.literal: Then a cloud appeared and enveloped them and a voice came from the cloud This is My beloved Son Listen to Him
verses.literalPt: E desceu uma nuvem que os cobriu com a sua sombra, e saiu da nuvem uma voz que dizia: Este é o meu filho amado; a ele ouvi.

verses.original: καὶ ἐξάπινα περιβλεψάμενοι οὐκέτι οὐδένα εἶδον ἀλλὰ τὸν Ἰησοῦν μόνον μεθ’ ἑαυτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai exapina periblepsamenoi ouketi oudena eidon alla ton Iēsoun monon meth’ heautōn
verses.literal: Suddenly when they looked around they saw no one with them except . . . Jesus
verses.literalPt: E, tendo olhado em redor, ninguém mais viram, senão só Jesus com eles.

verses.original: Καὶ καταβαινόντων αὐτῶν ἐκ τοῦ ὄρους διεστείλατο αὐτοῖς ἵνα μηδενὶ ἃ εἶδον διηγήσωνται εἰ μὴ ὅταν ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκ νεκρῶν ἀναστῇ
verses.transliteration: Kai katabainontōn autōn ek tou orous diesteilato autois hina mēdeni ha eidon diēgēsōntai ei mē hotan ho Huios tou anthrōpou ek nekrōn anastē
verses.literal: As they were coming down . . . the mountain Jesus admonished them not to tell anyone . . . what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead
verses.literalPt: E, descendo eles do monte, ordenou-lhes que a ninguém contassem o que tinham visto, até que o Filho do homem ressuscitasse dentre os mortos.

verses.original: καὶ τὸν λόγον ἐκράτησαν πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς συζητοῦντες τί ἐστιν τὸ ἐκ νεκρῶν ἀναστῆναι
verses.transliteration: kai ton logon ekratēsan pros heautous syzētountes ti estin to ek nekrōn anastēnai
verses.literal: So they kept this matter to themselves discussing what it meant to rise from the dead
verses.literalPt: E eles retiveram o caso entre si, perguntando uns aos outros que seria aquilo, ressuscitar dentre os mortos.

verses.original: καὶ ἐπηρώτων αὐτὸν λέγοντες Ὅτι Λέγουσιν οἱ γραμματεῖς ὅτι Ἠλίαν δεῖ ἐλθεῖν πρῶτον
verses.transliteration: kai epērōtōn auton legontes Hoti Legousin hoi grammateis hoti Ēlian dei elthein prōton
verses.literal: And they asked Jesus - Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first
verses.literalPt: E interrogaram-no, dizendo: Por que dizem os escribas que é necessário que Elias venha primeiro?

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἔφη αὐτοῖς Ἠλίας μὲν ἐλθὼν πρῶτον ἀποκαθιστάνει πάντα καὶ πῶς γέγραπται ἐπὶ τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἵνα πολλὰ πάθῃ καὶ ἐξουδενηθῇ
verses.transliteration: Ho de ephē autois Ēlias men elthōn prōton apokathistanei panta kai pōs gegraptai epi ton Huion tou anthrōpou hina polla pathē kai exoudenēthē
verses.literal: He replied . . . Elijah does indeed come first and he restores all things Why then is it written that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected
verses.literalPt: E, respondendo ele, disse-lhes: Em verdade Elias virá primeiro, e todas as coisas restaurará; e, como está escrito do Filho do homem, que ele deva padecer muito e ser aviltado.

verses.original: ἀλλὰ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι καὶ Ἠλίας ἐλήλυθεν καὶ ἐποίησαν αὐτῷ ὅσα ἤθελον καθὼς γέγραπται ἐπ’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: alla legō hymin hoti kai Ēlias elēlythen kai epoiēsan autō hosa ēthelon kathōs gegraptai ep’ auton
verses.literal: But I tell you that Elijah has indeed come and they have done to him whatever they wished just as it is written about him
verses.literalPt: Digo-vos, porém, que Elias já veio, e fizeram-lhe tudo o que quiseram, como dele está escrito.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐλθόντες πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς εἶδον ὄχλον πολὺν περὶ αὐτοὺς καὶ γραμματεῖς συζητοῦντας πρὸς αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Kai elthontes pros tous mathētas eidon ochlon polyn peri autous kai grammateis syzētountas pros autous
verses.literal: When they returned to the other disciples they saw a large crowd around them and scribes arguing with them
verses.literalPt: E, quando se aproximou dos discípulos, viu ao redor deles grande multidão, e alguns escribas que disputavam com eles.

verses.original: καὶ εὐθὺς πᾶς ὁ ὄχλος ἰδόντες αὐτὸν ἐξεθαμβήθησαν καὶ προστρέχοντες ἠσπάζοντο αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai euthys pas ho ochlos idontes auton exethambēthēsan kai prostrechontes ēspazonto auton
verses.literal: As soon as all the people saw Jesus they were filled with awe and ran to greet Him
verses.literalPt: E logo toda a multidão, vendo-o, ficou espantada e, correndo para ele, o saudaram.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτούς Τί συζητεῖτε πρὸς αὑτούς
verses.transliteration: Kai epērōtēsen autous Ti syzēteite pros hautous
verses.literal: What are you disputing with them He asked
verses.literalPt: E perguntou aos escribas: Que é que discutis com eles?

verses.original: Καὶ ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ εἷς ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου Διδάσκαλε ἤνεγκα τὸν υἱόν μου πρὸς σέ ἔχοντα πνεῦμα ἄλαλον
verses.transliteration: Kai apekrithē autō heis ek tou ochlou Didaskale ēnenka ton huion mou pros se echonta pneuma alalon
verses.literal: Someone in the crowd replied Teacher I brought . . . You my son who has a spirit that makes him mute
verses.literalPt: E um da multidão, respondendo, disse: Mestre, trouxe-te o meu filho, que tem um espírito mudo;

verses.original: καὶ ὅπου ἐὰν αὐτὸν καταλάβῃ ῥήσσει αὐτόν καὶ ἀφρίζει καὶ τρίζει τοὺς ὀδόντας καὶ ξηραίνεται καὶ εἶπα τοῖς μαθηταῖς σου ἵνα αὐτὸ ἐκβάλωσιν καὶ οὐκ ἴσχυσαν
verses.transliteration: kai hopou ean auton katalabē rhēssei auton kai aphrizei kai trizei tous odontas kai xērainetai kai eipa tois mathētais sou hina auto ekbalōsin kai ouk ischysan
verses.literal: Whenever . . . it seizes him it throws him to the ground . . . He foams at the mouth gnashes his teeth and becomes rigid I asked Your disciples to drive it out . . . but they were unable
verses.literalPt: E este, onde quer que o apanha, despedaça-o, e ele espuma, e range os dentes, e vai definhando; e eu disse aos teus discípulos que o expulsassem, e não puderam.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς αὐτοῖς λέγει Ὦ γενεὰ ἄπιστος ἕως πότε πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἔσομαι ἕως πότε ἀνέξομαι ὑμῶν φέρετε αὐτὸν πρός με
verses.transliteration: Ho de apokritheis autois legei Ō genea apistos heōs pote pros hymas esomai heōs pote anexomai hymōn pherete auton pros me
verses.literal: O unbelieving generation - Jesus replied How long . . . must I remain with you How long . . . must I put up with you Bring the boy to Me
verses.literalPt: E ele, respondendo-lhes, disse: Ó geração incrédula! até quando estarei convosco? até quando vos sofrerei ainda? Trazei-mo.

verses.original: Καὶ ἤνεγκαν αὐτὸν πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ ἰδὼν αὐτὸν τὸ πνεῦμα εὐθὺς συνεσπάραξεν αὐτόν καὶ πεσὼν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἐκυλίετο ἀφρίζων
verses.transliteration: Kai ēnenkan auton pros auton kai idōn auton to pneuma euthys synesparaxen auton kai pesōn epi tēs gēs ekylieto aphrizōn
verses.literal: So they brought him - and seeing Jesus the spirit immediately threw the boy into a convulsion . . . He fell to the ground and rolled around foaming at the mouth
verses.literalPt: E trouxeram-lho; e quando ele o viu, logo o espírito o agitou com violência, e, caindo o endemoninhado por terra, revolvia-se, escumando.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ Πόσος χρόνος ἐστὶν ὡς τοῦτο γέγονεν αὐτῷ Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Ἐκ παιδιόθεν
verses.transliteration: Kai epērōtēsen ton patera autou Posos chronos estin hōs touto gegonen autō Ho de eipen Ek paidiothen
verses.literal: Jesus asked the boy’s father How long . . . . . . . . . has this been with him From childhood - he said
verses.literalPt: E perguntou ao pai dele: Quanto tempo há que lhe sucede isto? E ele disse-lhe: Desde a infância.

verses.original: καὶ πολλάκις καὶ εἰς πῦρ αὐτὸν ἔβαλεν καὶ εἰς ὕδατα ἵνα ἀπολέσῃ αὐτόν ἀλλ’ εἴ τι δύνῃ βοήθησον ἡμῖν σπλαγχνισθεὶς ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: kai pollakis kai eis pyr auton ebalen kai eis hydata hina apolesē auton all’ ei ti dynē boēthēson hēmin splanchnistheis eph’ hēmas
verses.literal: It often throws him into the fire or into the water trying to kill him But if You can do anything have compassion on us and help us
verses.literalPt: E muitas vezes o tem lançado no fogo, e na água, para o destruir; mas, se tu podes fazer alguma coisa, tem compaixão de nós, e ajuda-nos.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Τὸ Εἰ δύνῃ πάντα δυνατὰ τῷ πιστεύοντι
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous eipen autō To Ei dynē panta dynata tō pisteuonti
verses.literal: If You can - echoed Jesus All things are possible to him who believes
verses.literalPt: E Jesus disse-lhe: Se tu podes crer, tudo é possível ao que crê.

verses.original: Εὐθὺς κράξας ὁ πατὴρ τοῦ παιδίου ἔλεγεν Πιστεύω βοήθει μου τῇ ἀπιστίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Euthys kraxas ho patēr tou paidiou elegen Pisteuō boēthei mou tē apistia
verses.literal: Immediately the boy’s father cried out I do believe help my unbelief
verses.literalPt: E logo o pai do menino, clamando, com lágrimas, disse: Eu creio, Senhor! ajuda a minha incredulidade.

verses.original: Ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἐπισυντρέχει ὄχλος ἐπετίμησεν τῷ πνεύματι τῷ ἀκαθάρτῳ λέγων αὐτῷ Τὸ ἄλαλον καὶ κωφὸν πνεῦμα ἐγὼ ἐπιτάσσω σοι ἔξελθε ἐξ αὐτοῦ καὶ μηκέτι εἰσέλθῃς εἰς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Idōn de ho Iēsous hoti episyntrechei ochlos epetimēsen tō pneumati tō akathartō legōn autō To alalon kai kōphon pneuma egō epitassō soi exelthe ex autou kai mēketi eiselthēs eis auton
verses.literal: When Jesus saw that a crowd had come running He rebuked the unclean spirit You deaf and mute spirit He said I command you to come out and never enter . . . him again
verses.literalPt: E Jesus, vendo que a multidão concorria, repreendeu o espírito imundo, dizendo-lhe: Espírito mudo e surdo, eu te ordeno: Sai dele, e não entres mais nele.

verses.original: Καὶ κράξας καὶ πολλὰ σπαράξας ἐξῆλθεν καὶ ἐγένετο ὡσεὶ νεκρὸς ὥστε τοὺς πολλοὺς λέγειν ὅτι ἀπέθανεν
verses.transliteration: Kai kraxas kai polla sparaxas exēlthen kai egeneto hōsei nekros hōste tous pollous legein hoti apethanen
verses.literal: After shrieking and convulsing him violently . . . the spirit came out The boy became like a corpse so that many said He is dead
verses.literalPt: E ele, clamando, e agitando-o com violência, saiu; e ficou o menino como morto, de tal maneira que muitos diziam que estava morto.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς κρατήσας τῆς χειρὸς αὐτοῦ ἤγειρεν αὐτόν καὶ ἀνέστη
verses.transliteration: ho de Iēsous kratēsas tēs cheiros autou ēgeiren auton kai anestē
verses.literal: But Jesus took him by the hand and helped him to his feet . . . and he stood up
verses.literalPt: Mas Jesus, tomando-o pela mão, o ergueu, e ele se levantou.

verses.original: Καὶ εἰσελθόντος αὐτοῦ εἰς οἶκον οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ κατ’ ἰδίαν ἐπηρώτων αὐτόν Ὅτι ἡμεῖς οὐκ ἠδυνήθημεν ἐκβαλεῖν αὐτό
verses.transliteration: Kai eiselthontos autou eis oikon hoi mathētai autou kat’ idian epērōtōn auton Hoti hēmeis ouk ēdynēthēmen ekbalein auto
verses.literal: After Jesus had gone into the house His disciples asked Him privately Why couldn’t . . . we drive it out . . .
verses.literalPt: E, quando entrou em casa, os seus discípulos lhe perguntaram à parte: Por que o não pudemos nós expulsar?

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τοῦτο τὸ γένος ἐν οὐδενὶ δύναται ἐξελθεῖν εἰ μὴ ἐν προσευχῇ
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen autois Touto to genos en oudeni dynatai exelthein ei mē en proseuchē
verses.literal: Jesus answered This kind cannot . . . . . . come out except . . . by prayer
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhes: Esta casta não pode sair com coisa alguma, a não ser com oração e jejum.

verses.original: Κἀκεῖθεν ἐξελθόντες παρεπορεύοντο διὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ οὐκ ἤθελεν ἵνα τις γνοῖ
verses.transliteration: Kakeithen exelthontes pareporeuonto dia tēs Galilaias kai ouk ēthelen hina tis gnoi
verses.literal: Going on from there they passed through Galilee But Jesus did not want anyone to know
verses.literalPt: E, tendo partido dali, caminharam pela Galiléia, e não queria que alguém o soubesse;

verses.original: ἐδίδασκεν γὰρ τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς ὅτι Ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοται εἰς χεῖρας ἀνθρώπων καὶ ἀποκτενοῦσιν αὐτόν καὶ ἀποκτανθεὶς μετὰ τρεῖς ἡμέρας ἀναστήσεται
verses.transliteration: edidasken gar tous mathētas autou kai elegen autois hoti Ho Huios tou anthrōpou paradidotai eis cheiras anthrōpōn kai apoktenousin auton kai apoktantheis meta treis hēmeras anastēsetai
verses.literal: because He was teaching His disciples He told them The Son of Man will be delivered into the hands of men They will kill Him and after three days He will rise
verses.literalPt: Porque ensinava os seus discípulos, e lhes dizia: O Filho do homem será entregue nas mãos dos homens, e matá-lo-ão; e, morto ele, ressuscitará ao terceiro dia.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ἠγνόουν τὸ ῥῆμα καὶ ἐφοβοῦντο αὐτὸν ἐπερωτῆσαι
verses.transliteration: hoi de ēgnooun to rhēma kai ephobounto auton eperōtēsai
verses.literal: But they did not understand this statement and they were afraid to ask Him about it
verses.literalPt: Mas eles não entendiam esta palavra, e receavam interrogá-lo.

verses.original: Καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Καφαρναούμ Καὶ ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ γενόμενος ἐπηρώτα αὐτούς Τί ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ διελογίζεσθε
verses.transliteration: Kai ēlthon eis Kapharnaoum Kai en tē oikia genomenos epērōta autous Ti en tē hodō dielogizesthe
verses.literal: Then they came to Capernaum While Jesus was in the house He asked them What were you discussing on the way
verses.literalPt: E chegou a Cafarnaum e, entrando em casa, perguntou-lhes: Que estáveis vós discutindo pelo caminho?

verses.original: οἱ δὲ ἐσιώπων πρὸς ἀλλήλους γὰρ διελέχθησαν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ τίς μείζων
verses.transliteration: hoi de esiōpōn pros allēlous gar dielechthēsan en tē hodō tis meizōn
verses.literal: But they were silent for on the way they had been arguing about . . . . . . which of them was the greatest
verses.literalPt: Mas eles calaram-se; porque pelo caminho tinham disputado entre si qual era o maior.

verses.original: Καὶ καθίσας ἐφώνησεν τοὺς δώδεκα καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Εἴ τις θέλει πρῶτος εἶναι ἔσται πάντων ἔσχατος καὶ πάντων διάκονος
verses.transliteration: Kai kathisas ephōnēsen tous dōdeka kai legei autois Ei tis thelei prōtos einai estai pantōn eschatos kai pantōn diakonos
verses.literal: Sitting down Jesus called the Twelve and said If anyone wants to be first he must be the last of all and the servant of all
verses.literalPt: E ele, assentando-se, chamou os doze, e disse-lhes: Se alguém quiser ser o primeiro, será o derradeiro de todos e o servo de todos.

verses.original: Καὶ λαβὼν παιδίον ἔστησεν αὐτὸ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν καὶ ἐναγκαλισάμενος αὐτὸ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: Kai labōn paidion estēsen auto en mesō autōn kai enankalisamenos auto eipen autois
verses.literal: Then He had a little child stand among them Taking the child in His arms . . . He said to them
verses.literalPt: E, lançando mão de um menino, pô-lo no meio deles e, tomando-o nos seus braços, disse-lhes:

verses.original: Ὃς ἂν ἓν τῶν τοιούτων παιδίων δέξηται ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου ἐμὲ δέχεται καὶ ὃς ἂν ἐμὲ δέχηται οὐκ ἐμὲ δέχεται ἀλλὰ τὸν ἀποστείλαντά με
verses.transliteration: Hos an hen tōn toioutōn paidiōn dexētai epi tō onomati mou eme dechetai kai hos an eme dechētai ouk eme dechetai alla ton aposteilanta me
verses.literal: Whoever . . . welcomes one of these little children in My name welcomes Me and whoever . . . welcomes Me welcomes not only Me but the One who sent Me
verses.literalPt: Qualquer que receber um destes meninos em meu nome, a mim me recebe; e qualquer que a mim me receber, recebe, não a mim, mas ao que me enviou.

verses.original: Ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰωάννης Διδάσκαλε εἴδομέν τινα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἐκβάλλοντα δαιμόνια ὃς οὐκ ἀκολουθεῖ ἡμῖν καὶ ἐκωλύομεν αὐτόν ὅτι οὐκ ἠκολούθει ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: Ephē autō ho Iōannēs Didaskale eidomen tina en tō onomati sou ekballonta daimonia hos ouk akolouthei hēmin kai ekōlyomen auton hoti ouk ēkolouthei hēmin
verses.literal: John said to Him Teacher we saw someone else . . . . . . . . . driving out demons in Your name and we tried to stop him because . . . he does not accompany us
verses.literalPt: E João lhe respondeu, dizendo: Mestre, vimos um que em teu nome expulsava demônios, o qual não nos segue; e nós lho proibimos, porque não nos segue.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Μὴ κωλύετε αὐτόν οὐδεὶς γάρ ἐστιν ὃς ποιήσει δύναμιν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου καὶ δυνήσεται ταχὺ κακολογῆσαί με
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous eipen Mē kōlyete auton oudeis gar estin hos poiēsei dynamin epi tō onomati mou kai dynēsetai tachy kakologēsai me
verses.literal: Do not stop him - Jesus replied For no one who performs a miracle in My name can turn around and speak evil of Me
verses.literalPt: Jesus, porém, disse: Não lho proibais; porque ninguém há que faça milagre em meu nome e possa logo falar mal de mim.

verses.original: ὃς γὰρ οὐκ ἔστιν καθ’ ἡμῶν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: hos gar ouk estin kath’ hēmōn hyper hēmōn estin
verses.literal: For whoever is not against us is for us
verses.literalPt: Porque quem não é contra nós, é por nós.

verses.original: Ὃς γὰρ ἂν ποτίσῃ ὑμᾶς ποτήριον ὕδατος ἐν ὀνόματι ὅτι Χριστοῦ ἐστε ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐ μὴ ἀπολέσῃ τὸν μισθὸν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hos gar an potisē hymas potērion hydatos en onomati hoti Christou este amēn legō hymin hoti ou mē apolesē ton misthon autou
verses.literal: Indeed if anyone . . . gives you even a cup of water because you bear . . . the name of Christ truly I tell you he will never lose his reward
verses.literalPt: Porquanto, qualquer que vos der a beber um copo de água em meu nome, porque sois discípulos de Cristo, em verdade vos digo que não perderá o seu galardão.

verses.original: Καὶ ὃς ἂν σκανδαλίσῃ ἕνα τῶν μικρῶν τούτων τῶν πιστευόντων εἰς ἐμέ καλόν ἐστιν αὐτῷ μᾶλλον εἰ περίκειται μύλος ὀνικὸς περὶ τὸν τράχηλον αὐτοῦ καὶ βέβληται εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν
verses.transliteration: Kai hos an skandalisē hena tōn mikrōn toutōn tōn pisteuontōn eis eme kalon estin autō mallon ei perikeitai mylos onikos peri ton trachēlon autou kai beblētai eis tēn thalassan
verses.literal: But if anyone . . . causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble it would be better for him to have . . . a large millstone hung around his neck and to be thrown into the sea
verses.literalPt: E qualquer que escandalizar um destes pequeninos que crêem em mim, melhor lhe fora que lhe pusessem ao pescoço uma mó de atafona, e que fosse lançado no mar.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐὰν σκανδαλίζῃ σε ἡ χείρ σου ἀπόκοψον αὐτήν καλόν ἐστίν σε κυλλὸν εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν ζωὴν ἢ τὰς δύο χεῖρας ἔχοντα ἀπελθεῖν εἰς τὴν γέενναν εἰς τὸ πῦρ τὸ ἄσβεστον
verses.transliteration: Kai ean skandalizē se hē cheir sou apokopson autēn kalon estin se kyllon eiselthein eis tēn zōēn ē tas dyo cheiras echonta apelthein eis tēn geennan eis to pyr to asbeston
verses.literal: If your hand causes you to sin . . . cut it off . . . It is better for you to enter . . . life crippled than to have two hands and go into hell into the unquenchable fire
verses.literalPt: E, se a tua mão te escandalizar, corta-a; melhor é para ti entrares na vida aleijado do que, tendo duas mãos, ires para o inferno, para o fogo que nunca se apaga,
Onde o seu bicho não morre, e o fogo nunca se apaga.

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν ὁ πούς σου σκανδαλίζῃ σε ἀπόκοψον αὐτόν καλόν ἐστίν σε εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν ζωὴν χωλὸν ἢ τοὺς δύο πόδας ἔχοντα βληθῆναι εἰς τὴν γέενναν
verses.transliteration: kai ean ho pous sou skandalizē se apokopson auton kalon estin se eiselthein eis tēn zōēn chōlon ē tous dyo podas echonta blēthēnai eis tēn geennan
verses.literal: If your foot causes you to sin . . . cut it off . . . It is better for you to enter . . . life lame than to have two feet and be thrown into hell
verses.literalPt: E, se o teu pé te escandalizar, corta-o; melhor é para ti entrares coxo na vida do que, tendo dois pés, seres lançado no inferno, no fogo que nunca se apaga,
Onde o seu bicho não morre, e o fogo nunca se apaga.

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου σκανδαλίζῃ σε ἔκβαλε αὐτόν καλόν σέ ἐστιν μονόφθαλμον εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἢ δύο ὀφθαλμοὺς ἔχοντα βληθῆναι εἰς τὴν γέενναν
verses.transliteration: kai ean ho ophthalmos sou skandalizē se ekbale auton kalon se estin monophthalmon eiselthein eis tēn basileian tou Theou ē dyo ophthalmous echonta blēthēnai eis tēn geennan
verses.literal: And if your eye causes you to sin . . . pluck it out . . . It is better for you to enter . . . the kingdom of God with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell
verses.literalPt: E, se o teu olho te escandalizar, lança-o fora; melhor é para ti entrares no reino de Deus com um só olho do que, tendo dois olhos, seres lançado no fogo do inferno,

verses.original: ὅπου Ὁ σκώληξ αὐτῶν οὐ τελευτᾷ καὶ τὸ πῦρ οὐ σβέννυται
verses.transliteration: hopou Ho skōlēx autōn ou teleuta kai to pyr ou sbennytai
verses.literal: where their worm never dies and the fire is never quenched
verses.literalPt: Onde o seu bicho não morre, e o fogo nunca se apaga.

verses.original: Πᾶς γὰρ πυρὶ ἁλισθήσεται
verses.transliteration: Pas gar pyri halisthēsetai
verses.literal: For everyone will be salted with fire
verses.literalPt: Porque cada um será salgado com fogo, e cada sacrifício será salgado com sal.

verses.original: καλὸν τὸ ἅλας ἐὰν δὲ τὸ ἅλας ἄναλον γένηται ἐν τίνι αὐτὸ ἀρτύσετε ἔχετε ἐν ἑαυτοῖς ἅλα καὶ εἰρηνεύετε ἐν ἀλλήλοις
verses.transliteration: kalon to halas ean de to halas analon genētai en tini auto artysete echete en heautois hala kai eirēneuete en allēlois
verses.literal: Salt is good but if the salt loses its saltiness with what will you season it Have salt among yourselves and be at peace with one another
verses.literalPt: Bom é o sal; mas, se o sal se tornar insípido, com que o temperareis? Tende sal em vós mesmos, e paz uns com os outros.
